data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-b-s', Mahbasah means 'tender heart' or 'affectionate'. This beautiful name is mentioned in the Quran, where it is used to describe the tender mercy and compassion of Allah towards His creation. The name Mahbasah carries the meaning “Tender Heart” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahbasah usually hope their child will grow to embody tender heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
